metadata.notes: First E9_MULTI_METHOD demonstration: gf2_algebraic (Lean4/ring over ZMod 2) + sat_refutation (cake_lpr/HOL4). Lean sha256=95c4a83356d5bd15…, CNF sha256=5d94d1a0f0d5749b…. Both encodings validated against the same Boolean truth table.

natural_language: The Boolean tautology (a∧b)∨(a∧¬b)↔a is verified by two formally-anchored but methodologically independent routes: (1) GF(2) algebraic identity over ZMod 2 in Lean 4 (gf2_and_or_identity: ring closes a * b + a * (1-b) = a); (2) SAT refutation — the negation of the tautology is encoded as a Tseitin CNF, CaDiCaL produces UNSAT with an LRAT proof, and cake_lpr — a CakeML binary whose LRAT-checking logic is formally proven correct in HOL4 — accepts that proof. The cross-translation validator confirms both encodings describe the same Boolean function. Two distinct methods (gf2_algebraic, sat_refutation) in two distinct formal families (lean4, cake_lpr) → E9.
title: Cross-method certificate — (a∧b)∨(a∧¬b)↔a
